calculation_steps: Import current-phase I=Ic sin phi and voltage V=(Phi0/2pi)phi_dot, derive EJ and effective inertia M=C(Phi0/2pi)^2.
Derive physical omega0=sqrt(EJ/M) and exact trapped period via elliptic K; AGM identity gives normalized frequency.
Exact rational expansions of K and sin yield -1/16 at quadratic order and +1/3072 at quartic order in amplitude.
For 0<a<pi, AGM(1,cos(a/2))<1, so physical frequency strictly softens.
For positive-star lambda>=0 and r3>=0 with zero amplitude mapped to zero, normalized native frequency>=1; incompatibility independent of amplitude scale.
If allow negative lambda and map r3=kappa a², matching first physical coefficient requires lambda*kappa=-1/16; this is a fitted physical import, not a UD derivation.
Numerical float64 AGM vs independent Simpson-K integral agree within 1e-11 for five a fixtures; sample Ic,C only design scenarios.

result.physical_interpretation: FAILED positive-star JJ mapping; no unique UD physical mechanism

counterexamples_and_failures: Josephson cosine softens under amplitude, contradicts positive-star hidden UD quartic hardening with monotone zero-to-zero map.
Dropping lambda>=0 permits a negative quartic coefficient matched from physical data, but bare quartic is globally unbounded below and not native selected.
Conventional Josephson circuit gives entire curve; no incremental UD physical prediction.
Physical superconducting phase is not the same typed object as UD J-fiber angle.

No physical UD source-to-junction port coupling, geometry or time map derived.
